# Journey Church Brand

> Brand guide and design system for Journey Church, Jacksonville, FL — voice, colors, type, logos, ministry branding and every approved graphic.

Read the full guide before writing or designing anything for Journey Church.

## Guide
- [Brand guide (full, plain text)](/brand/brand.md): voice rules, colors, type, layout, graphic sizes, logos, ministry branding, and a catalog of every design.
- [Visual brand site](/brand/): browse every design and download PNGs.
